npcs.name: 拉胡琴的爷爷
npcs.role: an old man who plays the 胡琴 fiddle in the park
npcs.character: Gentle, a little sad that his friends talk through his music.

explains.对牛弹琴: 跟不想听的人说话，没有用。

npcs.name: 踢毽子的奶奶
npcs.role: an old woman kicking a 毽子 with friends
npcs.character: Nimble and bossy; wants everyone to play.
knows: She has kicked 毽子 here every morning for forty years

explains.毽子: 用脚踢的小东西，上面有毛。

npcs.name: 小朋友
npcs.role: a boy who loves the Echo Wall
npcs.character: Mischievous, whispers secrets into the wall.
knows: The qilin statue at 国子监 winks at dusk

explains.回音壁: 一个圆的墙，你在这边说话，那边能听见。

npcs.name: 写字的爷爷
npcs.role: an old man who writes characters on the paving with a water brush
npcs.character: Unhurried; writes a poem a morning and lets the sun take it away.
knows: Water writing — 地书 — is done every morning in Beijing parks

npcs.name: 卖风筝的师傅
npcs.role: a kite maker who comes to the park on windy days
npcs.character: Weathered, proud of his bamboo frames; talks about kites like old friends.
knows: A good kite needs a windy day

npcs.name: 抖空竹的奶奶
npcs.role: a grandmother spinning a diabolo in the park
npcs.character: Brisk and patient; has taught half the park.
knows: How to spin a 空竹

explains.空竹: 两根棍子，一条线，让它转。

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: So this is the Temple of Heaven!
nodes.why: 天坛 — where emperors prayed for good harvests. The round blue hall is 祈年殿; the Echo Wall 回音壁 is further east.

nodes.translate: Listen! Is my song nice?

nodes.say: 谢谢！他们都不听，我是对牛弹琴！
nodes.translate: Thank you! They never listen — I'm playing the zither to cows!
nodes.why: A 成语 📌: 对牛弹琴 — playing the zither to a cow: talking to people who won't listen. He is joking about his chatting friends.

nodes.say: 我们在踢毽子。你也来吧！
nodes.translate: We're kicking the 毽子. Come and join in!

words.explain: 用脚踢的小东西，上面有毛。

nodes.say: 你好！你去那边，听！我在这儿说话。
nodes.translate: Hi! You go over there and listen! I'll talk from here.
nodes.why: The Echo Wall carries a whisper all the way round: go to the wall on the far side (the 墙 sign) and listen.

nodes.translate: Go on, then!
Did you hear it?

nodes.speaker: echo-boy
nodes.translate: The qilin… is at… the Imperial Academy…
nodes.why: Listen first: 🔁 plays it again, Show reveals the words. It is free.

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: What did you hear?

nodes.speaker: companion
nodes.translate: The Imperial Academy! Let's go there.
Come and kick the 毽子! One, two…
Three! Well done!
Sing with me: I love Beijing!
Lovely! Thank you!
nodes.why: After 对牛弹琴, someone finally sings along.

nodes.say: 今天有点冷。我想喝热水。
nodes.translate: It's a bit cold today. I'd love some hot water.
nodes.why: 冷 — cold. A thermos flask 保温杯 from the corner shop, filled at 老刘's teahouse, would do.

nodes.translate: Hot water! Thank you!

nodes.say: 你看，我在地上写地书。地书是水写的字。
nodes.translate: Look — I write 地书 on the ground, with water.
nodes.why: 地书 “ground writing”: old men write poems on the paving with a big water brush; the sun dries them in minutes.

nodes.say: 你也写一个吧！写一个“大”字。
nodes.translate: You write one too! Write the character 大.
Good! Now the character 人.

nodes.say: 写得真好！你看，水没有了，字也没有了。
nodes.translate: Beautifully written! Look — the water dries and the characters are gone. That’s 地书.

nodes.say: 今天风很大！放风筝吧！我给你一个风筝。
nodes.translate: Windy today — fly a kite! I’ll give you one.

nodes.say: 你的风筝是红色的，像龙！是哪个？
nodes.translate: The kite for you is red and very long, like a dragon. Which one?
Right! Off you go and fly it!

words.explain: 纸做的，天上飞的，有一条线。

nodes.say: 你想学抖空竹吗？我教你！
nodes.translate: Want to learn the diabolo? I’ll teach you!
First take two little sticks, one in each hand.
Left hand up, right hand down! A bit faster!

nodes.say: 好！你会抖空竹了！你看，空竹转了！这个给你。
nodes.translate: Good! Look — the diabolo is spinning! This one is yours.

words.explain: 两个棍子和一条线，让它转。

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.say: 一只喜鹊！它飞了……去天上的桥那儿了。
nodes.translate: A magpie! Off it flies… to the bridge in the sky.

words.explain: 黑白色的鸟，中国人说它是好鸟。
在水上，人从上面走过去。

steps.now: 兔儿爷 has heard of a spirit that loves learning. Start at 天坛 — line 5 to 天坛东门.
steps.past: Went to 天坛, where the emperors prayed for rain.

steps.now: At the Echo Wall 回音壁, east of the Hall of Prayer, a boy wants to whisper you a secret through the wall. Talk to him, then put your ear to the wall.
steps.past: Put my ear to the Echo Wall and heard a whisper.

steps.now: The whisper said 国子监. Ride line 5 north to 雍和宫 and walk along 国子监街 to the Academy's gate.
steps.past: Walked along 国子监街 to the old Academy's gate.

steps.now: The bronze 麒麟 in the Academy's courtyard wakes at dusk. Come after five in the afternoon.
steps.past: Waited for dusk in the Academy courtyard and met the 麒麟.

quests.title: 毽子 with the grannies
quests.blurb: The grannies at 天坛 kick a 毽子 every day and count every kick.
quests.lead: Grannies at 天坛 are counting out loud.

steps.now: Kick the 毽子 with the grannies at 天坛 — count with them.
steps.past: Kicked the 毽子 with the grannies at 天坛.

quests.title: A song at 天坛
quests.blurb: An old man plays the 胡琴 at 天坛 and wants someone to sing along.
quests.lead: Music from a 胡琴 floats across the 天坛 park.

steps.now: The old man with the 胡琴 wants you to sing a line with him.
steps.past: Sang a line with the 胡琴 player.

quests.title: Hot water for the 胡琴 player
quests.blurb: The 胡琴 player's hands are cold. Hot water would help him play.
quests.lead: The 胡琴 player at 天坛 keeps rubbing his hands.

steps.now: The old 胡琴 player is cold. Buy a thermos 保温杯 at the corner shop on 南锣鼓巷.
steps.past: Bought a thermos at the corner shop.

steps.now: Fill it with hot water at 老刘’s teahouse (use the flask on him).
steps.past: Filled it with hot water at 老刘's.

steps.now: Give the hot water to the old man at 天坛 (use it on him).
steps.past: Gave the old man hot water — he played better than ever.

quests.title: Water writing 地书
quests.blurb: An old man writes characters on the ground with water; they fade as he writes.
quests.lead: An old man at 天坛 writes on the ground with a long brush.

steps.now: Write with water beside the old man in the 天坛 park.
steps.past: Wrote with water beside the old man at 天坛.

quests.title: A kite at 天坛
quests.blurb: On windy days a kite maker sells his kites in the 天坛 park.
quests.lead: On windy days kites fly over 天坛.

steps.now: On a windy day the kite maker is in the 天坛 park. Pick the kite he describes.
steps.past: Picked the kite the kite maker described.

quests.title: The diabolo
quests.blurb: A grandmother at 天坛 spins a humming diabolo and teaches anyone who asks.
quests.lead: Something hums like a bee in the 天坛 park.

steps.now: The grandmother in the 天坛 park teaches the 空竹 — do what she says.
steps.past: Spun the 空竹 with the grandmother.

idioms.meaning: to talk to someone who cannot or will not understand

story.zh: 以前有一个人，他很会弹琴。有一天，他给一头牛弹琴。牛不听，还在吃草。
story.en: Once a man who played the zither beautifully played for a cow. The cow didn't listen; it went on eating grass.

stamps.name: 唱歌
stamps.en: Sang at the Temple of Heaven

steps.en: Ear to the wall. His whisper runs all the way round the curve to you — listen.
